qualification: local pinned-fixture userspace and workload evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

fixture.commandLine: console=ttyS0 earlycon=uart,io,0x3f8,115200 panic=-1 rdinit=/init plus a unique runner-owned dory.pvh_run_id

admission.registerDestination: ADD/ADC/SUB/SBB/CMP/AND/TEST/OR/XOR with byte, word, dword, or qword scalar memory source
admission.memoryDestination: only the measured read-only word TEST-immediate family
admission.deferred: all other memory-destination, memory-writing, and atomic ALU forms

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,432 tests in 171 suites passed; one pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verification.differentialCoverage: All four scalar widths and register-destination ADD/ADC/SUB/SBB/CMP/AND/OR/XOR match the interpreter; the exact GS-relative word TEST-immediate block covers both branch outcomes; failed reads leave architectural state restartable.
verification.negativeAdmissionCoverage: Qword memory CMP-immediate, qword memory TEST-register, and byte memory TEST-immediate remain explicit tier-one declines.

broadAdmissionRejection.failure: The kernel executed an NX-protected freed init-text page during a timer interrupt and panicked before the userspace receipt.
broadAdmissionRejection.isolation: A temporary release build that retained register-destination memory ALU but declined every memory-destination form passed all seven workloads and powered off after 736,834,005 instructions in 140.826 seconds.
broadAdmissionRejection.decision: The production boundary admits only the independently exercised measured word TEST-immediate family; broader memory-destination lowering remains unavailable.

comparisonToMixedTierRecovery.note: This is a single run before and after the slice. It demonstrates direction and correctness, not statistical performance.

interpretation: The bounded memory-ALU slice removes both selected measured decline sites while preserving a complete userspace boot and workload pass. It does not close A05.2: 132,578 of 231,022 tier-one attempts still declined, so the legacy baseline remains required.
limitations: The successful comparison contains one local full run per source state on one Apple M2 Pro; no confidence interval or cross-host conclusion is claimed.
The rejected broad-admission run is retained as negative engineering evidence and must not be treated as a passing result.
The diagnostic runner marks all records releaseQualified=false; this receipt does not satisfy the later G1-G5 qualification gates.
Raw runner diagnostics remain in the ignored local .dory-build directory.
